qolFindings.title: With the telephone off, a birth date in the Telefono column that is not written D/M/Y is still dropped with no notice
qolFindings.scenario: Probe round6/misc.probe V, readPhone false. 'Veldor;Marta;;16;2010-03-12', 'Veldor;Marta;;16;12 / 03 / 2010' and 'Veldor;Marta;;16;12032010' each become a student with age 16, no birth date, no unread line and no reason shown. The negative lookahead in LOOKS_LIKE_PHONE excludes only a date with the day first and no spaces. The self-review says 'a date in the ignored Telefono column is shown as an unread line'. That holds only for D/M/Y dates. The failure needs two deviations from the stated format at once (the value one column too far and a non-D/M/Y date), so it is rare, and no wrong student is saved. By contrast, '--' and 'n/a' there become visible unread lines, so nothing is lost in those cases.
qolFindings.suggestedFix: With the telephone off, treat a value as a telephone only when it has 9 or more digits, or when it contains no 19xx/20xx year group. Add the ISO case to the corpus. Otherwise narrow the claim to 'a D/M/Y date'.

previousFindingsVerified.note: EMPTY_FIELD (rosterPaste.ts:107) is applied to the three optional fields (:192). A field that is only '-', '–', '—', 'N/D', 'n.d.' or 'nd' now counts as empty. A placeholder must fill the whole field, so no real value can be hidden behind one. Probes: 'Veldor;Marta;12/03/2010;-;N/D' reads the date with no age and no phone. With readPhone on, 'N/D' and '-' read as an empty phone and the line is not refused. '-;-;-' gives a row with nothing read, still to be reviewed. A D/M/Y date in the ignored Telefono column is now an unread line that names the value. Corpus cases are at rosterPaste.corpus.ts:286 and :296. parser-robustness.json shows 30/30 and was recorded at 11:04:45Z, after rosterPaste.ts and the corpus were last written (13:04:33 and 13:04:38 local, UTC+2). rosterPaste.test.ts passes. Residual: V6-1.
